nodes.label: Cantara Street Parking Structures
nodes.description: West-side parking structures off Cantara Street. Serves Buildings 2, 3, 3A, and 4. Rooftop parking available on the member structure.

nodes.label: Ventura Canyon / Willard Parking Structure
nodes.description: East-side parking structure off Roscoe Boulevard. Serves Buildings 5, 6, the Hospital, and the Emergency Department.

nodes.label: Building 3A patient drop-off
nodes.description: Patient drop-off and pickup loop in front of Building 3A.

nodes.label: Building 2
nodes.description: Building 2 main entrance, the first building you see from Cantara parking. Automatic accessible doors.

nodes.label: Building 3
nodes.description: Building 3 main entrance behind a covered walkway with glass automatic doors. Houses lab, X-ray, OB/GYN, pharmacy.

nodes.label: Building 3A
nodes.description: Building 3A annex entrance, attached to Building 3, near the patient drop-off loop.

nodes.label: Building 4
nodes.description: Building 4 main entrance, past Building 3 on the right when walking from Cantara. Automatic accessible doors.

nodes.label: Building 5
nodes.description: Building 5 ground-floor entrance. Newer 3-story specialty building with a glass atrium, opened 2014. Automatic accessible doors.

nodes.label: Building 6
nodes.description: Building 6 ground-floor entrance, directly ahead from Ventura Canyon parking. Pharmacy, urgent care, dermatology, allergy.

nodes.label: Hospital main entrance
nodes.description: Main hospital entrance with the large Kaiser sign. Automatic doors, accessible.

nodes.label: Emergency Department entrance
nodes.description: Separate emergency entrance with red signage. Open 24/7. Automatic doors, fully accessible.

nodes.label: Covered walkway to Building 3
nodes.description: Covered outdoor walkway leading to the Building 3 glass-door entrance. Patients pass under it walking from Cantara parking.

nodes.label: Courtyard fountain
nodes.description: Open courtyard with a fountain between Building 3 and Building 4. A common cross-campus reference point.

nodes.label: Building 5 glass atrium
nodes.description: Three-story glass atrium on the east side of campus. The most recognizable building on campus.

nodes.label: Red Emergency sign
nodes.description: Large red EMERGENCY sign on the east side of the hospital, marking the separate ER entrance.

nodes.label: Building 5 to Hospital bridge
nodes.description: Enclosed pedestrian bridge connecting Building 5 to the Hospital, accessible from the upper level.

nodes.label: Kaiser hospital sign
nodes.description: Large Kaiser sign at the front of the hospital, visible from Ventura Canyon parking.

nodes.label: Building 3 basement (Area 060)
nodes.description: Basement level of Building 3. Lab/Blood Draw and X-ray/Bone Density.

nodes.label: Building 3 1st floor (Area 162)
nodes.description: Building 3 ground floor. Pharmacy and OB/GYN front desk.

nodes.label: Building 4 3rd floor
nodes.description: Building 4 third floor. Internal Medicine, Ophthalmology, and Cardiology (Area 308).

nodes.label: Building 5 Level 1 (Area 121)
nodes.description: Building 5 first level. Lab/Blood Draw reception and ground-floor imaging.

nodes.label: Building 5 Level 2
nodes.description: Building 5 second level. Audiology and Hearing.

nodes.label: Building 6 ground floor (Area 189)
nodes.description: Building 6 ground floor. Pharmacy, Urgent Care, Dermatology check-in.

nodes.label: Building 6 Floor 2 (Areas 290/291)
nodes.description: Building 6 second floor. Allergy (Area 290) and upper Dermatology (Area 291).

nodes.label: Hospital Radiology
nodes.description: Hospital main level Radiology / Diagnostic Imaging reception.

edges.instruction: Exit Cantara parking toward campus — Building 2 is on your left, the first building you see.
Exit Cantara parking toward campus — head straight for the covered walkway with the glass doors.
Walk under the covered walkway and through the automatic glass doors into Building 3.
From the covered walkway, Building 3A is just to your right, attached to Building 3.
Step out of the drop-off loop and through the automatic doors into Building 3A.
Walk past Building 3 toward the courtyard — the fountain is on your right.
Past the fountain, Building 4 is straight ahead on your right.
From Building 3, Building 4 is the next building over on your right.
From the fountain, keep walking east across campus — Building 5 with the glass atrium is straight ahead.
From Building 4, walk east across the courtyard — Building 5's glass atrium is the next building.
Exit Ventura Canyon parking toward Roscoe Blvd — Building 6 is directly ahead, look for the pharmacy and urgent care signs.
Exit Ventura Canyon parking — Building 5 with the glass atrium is to your left.
Exit Ventura Canyon parking and head left toward the large Kaiser sign at the hospital.
The main hospital entrance is just past the Kaiser sign — automatic doors.
Exit Ventura Canyon parking — look for the red EMERGENCY sign on the east side of the hospital.
Walk straight under the red sign through the automatic doors — this is the emergency entrance, separate from the main hospital doors.
From Building 6, Building 5 with the glass atrium is the next building west.
You're at the glass atrium entrance — Building 5.
Inside Building 5, take the elevator up and follow signs to the bridge to the hospital.
Cross the enclosed bridge — it lands on the upper level of the hospital, near the main entrance lobby.
Step outside the main entrance and walk to the right — the emergency entrance with the red sign is around the side.
Inside Building 3, take the elevator down to the basement level.
You're on the Building 3 ground floor — pharmacy is to your right, OB/GYN is straight ahead.
Inside Building 4, take the elevator to the 3rd floor.
You're on Building 5 Level 1 — reception is straight ahead.
Take the elevator from Level 1 up to Level 2.
You're on the Building 6 ground floor — pharmacy and urgent care check-in are straight ahead.
Inside Building 6, take the elevator up to the 2nd floor.
Inside the main hospital lobby, follow the signs to Radiology.
From Cantara parking, follow the loop road around to the Building 3A drop-off zone.
